text:
Mina: Need a concise DP plan for the Integration Sandbox cohort we'll propose in roadmap review tomorrow. Focus: onboarding cadence, what contract/SLA language we can offer for a 4-week sandbox, minimal delivery promises, feedback loop cadence, and what signals count as a go/no-go for expanding. Target 6 partners. Thoughts? :clipboard:
Theo: Suggest call it 'Integration Sandbox' not 'beta' — clearer expectations. Offer a 4-week window with defined milestones: week 0 onboarding, week 1 steady-state traffic, week 3 performance check, week 4 wrap + handoff. Must-haves: telemetry ingestion, exportable evals, and weekly syncs.
Jules: Contract scope: one-page sandbox addendum that includes data use (anonymized telemetry), rollback commitments, and a non-binding signaling clause (partners can give a "go" for next phase). Keep SLA informal: we commit to support hours + a response SLA (4 business hours for critical issues). No uptime SLA for sandbox.
Aria: Recruitment profile: teams with a clear integration plan (internal ticket or sprint) and ability to route a traffic slice (at least 5% of production). Avoid highly regulated sectors. Incentive: $400 credits + a technical integration report and a prioritized list of product asks from their feedback. Screen questions should check legal readiness and whether they can provide labeled examples.
Theo: Minimal promise list to partners: model pinning, a per-org telemetry dashboard, exportable eval CSV, a toggle to opt-out of experimental routing, and a documented rollback path. Do NOT promise kernel/driver-level work, custom quantization, or guaranteed latency targets in the sandbox.
Mina: Feedback cadence: weekly 30-min syncs + a short in-console survey after each sync + a shared issue board. Require a 30-example canonical set + 10 labeled failures for automated nightly diffs. We'll send a weekly diff deck and a summary of actions taken.
Jules: Go/no-go signals to recommend expansion:
- Technical: partner runs production-like traffic slice for >=5 days with no >25% regression in p95 and error_rate <1% absolute increase
- Value: partner reports measurable cost or latency improvements (>8% cost or >10% median latency) or a clear product ask to proceed
- Operational: partner completes onboarding checklist and engages in >=3 syncs
If >=2 signals true, recommend progression to Dedicated or extended trial.
Aria: Onboarding cadence and intake form snippet (for outreach):```
- org_name
- contact_name / email
- product_owner
- integration_ticket_link
- expected_traffic_slice_pct
- avg_prompt_tokens
- can_share_prompts (yes/no)
- legal_ready (yes/no)
- preferred_deployment (hosted/vpc)
- desired_start_date
```
Mina: Ops notes: must include per-org token cap and an alert webhook at 75% usage. We'll provide a fallback variant that traffic can be routed to if the partner hits cap. Also need an explicit field for expected labeled_examples_count to size eval pipelines.
Theo: Success metrics for the sandbox:
- Activation: >=70% of partners send traffic in week 1
- Quality stability: <=10% partners show >5% drop on baseline eval
- Signal yield: >=33% partners return a clear interest to continue or a prioritized roadmap ask
- Onboarding: >=80% complete the checklist in 5 business days
Jules: Action items:
- Theo: draft one-page sandbox addendum and webhook spec (ETA: today EOD)
- Aria: compile 10 high-fit outreach targets and outreach copy + intake form (ETA: today EOD)
- Mina: define telemetry keys & export schema + sample eval template (ETA: tomorrow AM)
counterparty-bot: forms-publish: integration-sandbox-intake v1 posted to /internal/sandbox-forms (status: success)
Aria: tiny tweak 12 include a "preferred_contact_timezone" in intake so we schedule syncs easier.
Mina: good call, added. If no objections I'll lock this wording for the roadmap slide. Thanks all. :sparkles:
